## Privacy And Safety

Do not include access tokens, recovery codes, private keys, private room IDs,
server secrets, personal contact details, or private infrastructure details in
this issue. For security-sensitive requests, use the reporting path in
the [repository security policy](https://github.com/Inter-Galactic-App/Inter-Galactic/security/policy) instead of a public issue.
